decisions.decision: Ship DDD/Onion/TDD/Atomic Design/Lean as defaults — predictable output out of the box; dissenters raise a workflow improvement
Partner In Crime ships as the default output style, minus the ADHD label — Zac's call
Generic rule wording is team-neutral; tailoring adds solo framing — Ang serves solo and teams
Pilot name via a hook-injected 'pilot' feature, not templating — spike passed 4/4; skills, rules and future features stay untouched
Tailoring is its own re-runnable command that /bootstrap-repo invokes — teammates joining a bootstrapped repo need a route in
Ang writes only inside the repo, never ~/.claude — Ang is bounded to one repo; Zac's call

Config moves to root ang.json (committed defaults) + gitignored ang.local.json overriding personal keys only (pilot, host); intent and streams are project-locked — per-user keys must not leak into team repos

Output style: up to 4 canned styles, Partner In Crime recommended default, plus a bounded under-a-minute interview (4–5 questions) as option 5 that suggests raising a workflow improvement — most users take a default
Cut per-user intent garnish and configurable config path — YAGNI, teams aren't in the release goal; extends-style shared config sent to docs-website to spike
Streams ship off by default, whatever happens to ang.json — Zac's requirement

Ang ships no ang.json; bootstrap keeps asking each feature question and writes a root ang.json. Ang's opinion: intent defaults to on (bootstrap then drafts 10k/intent.md, so validate passes); streams defaults to off. The loader's default for a missing key stays off. Personal keys (pilot, host) go to ang.local.json via the tailoring step. Zac's call, 2026-11-16
This repo gets its own real config (intent true, streams false; host orca local) replacing the src symlink — the repo is a user of Ang, not the default

ang.local.json is limited by a LOCAL_KEYS constant (host, pilot) in config.mjs, not a per-feature flag: the merge drops any other local key, so the config is always valid. validate warns about each dropped key, and the Ang config docs state the rule. Team-controlled overrides are parked. Why: a flag wouldn't pay off with 4 features, and flipping it means forking Ang. Zac's call
